assertions.text: The policy states: The filing limit is extended only where: (a) coverage was added retroactively, in which case the claim must be received within 120 days of the date the provider was notified; (b) another payer was primary, in which case the claim must be received within 60 days of the date on the primary payer's explanation of benefits; or (c) the delay was caused by the plan, as shown by plan correspondence.
